messages:
Lina: Observed a bunch of tenants with weird quota churn. digging in looks like the router's cross-tenant batcher is combining mixed-dim vectors and our units attribution is per-request, not per-vector, so one tall request inflates several tenants' estimated units.
Arjun: ouch. do we have a minimal repro?
Lina: yes — two tenants send same batch via multiplexed connection. one sends 1536-dim vectors, the other 256-dim. router packs them to GPU batch, server computes units = max_dim_based_units for the whole RPC and tags that to all sub-requests. console shows everyone paid for 1536-units.
Priya: schematic: clientA vectors(dim=1536) + clientB vectors(dim=256) -> multiplex batch -> server_est_units = units_for(1536,lengths) -> attribution: request-level.
Tom: why are we attributing at request level? historical reason: batching layer treated multiplex as single envelope to reduce accounting overhead. cheap but wrong now.
Maya: product hit: customers see sudden spikes, open support tickets. also affects per-tenant quotas since rate-limiter uses estimated units to throttle.
ingest-bot: log: batch=0xabc tenants=[acme,blueco] payload_bytes=2.1MB dominant_dim=1536 attributed_units=120 client_units_hints=[15,5] actual_per_vector_units=[120,10]
Arjun: proposal A: change attribution to per-subrequest by computing per-vector units before merging into batch. cost: CPU per-ingress but accurate.
Priya: proposal B: keep current fast path but add "fairshare correction" step where we prorate units by dominant-dim ratio unless any tenant opts into exact accounting. cheaper but heuristic.
Tom: telemetry first: we need metric embed.batch.multiplex.mismatch_count and embed.batch.attribution.mode with tags {fastpath|pervector|prorate}.
Lina: UX: console should surface "batching attribution" flag and a recent-events feed for tenants that had >2x difference between attributed and computed-per-vector units.
Maya: communications: we should proactively notify top-50 tenants this week about potential misattribution while we patch.
Arjun: rollout plan suggestion: 1) short-term: implement a server-side prorate heuristic behind flag (safe), enable for internal tenants -> 1718330000; 2) telemetry + alerting for mismatch -> 1718320000; 3) longer term: add per-vector accounting fastpath (optimized C++ loop) and enable as default -> 1718500000.
Priya: edgecases: some clients use streaming RPC where vectors arrive after initial headers; we must support attributing units as vectors complete. need to add partial-accounting signals in router protocol.
Tom: update router protocol: include per-subrequest vector-count and dominant-dim hint so batcher can cheaply compute prorate without deep-copying payload. header additions: `x-mux-vec-count: 3` `x-mux-dominant-dim: 1536`. small and backwards compatible.
Lina: security/compliance: attribution change affects billing; coordinate with finance before flipping defaults.
Maya: customer ops note: add dashboard filter to show "attribution_correction_applied" bool for last 30d.
Arjun: action items:
- Arjun: prototype prorate patch + metric embed.batch.multiplex.mismatch_count -> 1718320000 (ETA 48h)
- Priya: router header patch + spec PR -> 1718350000 (ETA 4 days)
- Tom: implement per-vector accounting fastpath plan + perf microbench -> 1718500000 (ETA 2 weeks)
- Maya: email draft to top-50 tenants + console banner copy -> 1718315000 (ETA 2 days)
- Lina: run backfill to quantify impacted tenants last 14 days -> 1718335000 (ETA 3 days)
ningest-bot: scheduled job queued: compute attribution_delta for last_14d for tenants with >500 requests.
Lina: ok thanks. prioritizing the prorate heuristic behind flag to reduce immediate support noise. will follow up with perf numbers. :eyes:
